scope: Original generated Academic Advisor Knowledge Package

checks.details: All tabular JSON representations match their corresponding Excel sheets row-for-row after normal spreadsheet null/numeric handling. Terminology was corrected to include the missing Pre-rq row.

Course codes, LTPC values, prerequisites, titles, semester and source-row lineage were verified against the original semester-spread workbook; observed title/code whitespace and line-break normalization is preserved as derived normalization.
148 minor-course records were verified against the original minor workbook; the four apparent prerequisite differences are only line-break/spacing normalization.
246 curriculum records were checked against their source cells; the only detected text mismatch was whitespace in 'Cloud &Cognitive Computing' versus the normalized spaced form.
COMP401 had no title and produced a bad retrieval document ('COMP401 — COMP401.'). It is now reference-only and unresolved rather than a fabricated canonical course entity.
Clear mechanical errors/formatting in MGMT209, MGMT330 and UCOR205 were normalized in derived canonical fields; all raw source variants remain preserved.
DATA405 prerequisite differed only by whitespace and was removed from the substantive conflict list.
Retrieval IDs are unique, every document has text and provenance, and no canonical course document is generated for the incomplete COMP401 record.
Source-linked records retain file, sheet and source-row lineage; course entities retain source observations.

important_finding: The original package was strong but not fully clean. The most important defect was COMP401 being promoted to a canonical course entity despite having no title, which caused a misleading retrieval document. A second issue was the normalized Excel Terminology sheet omitting Pre-rq even though the JSON glossary contained it. Several derived canonical titles also retained obvious mechanical errors.
